Problem.title: Closing the “Execution Gap”
Problem.subtitle: Over 90% of people fail their yearly goals. The problem isn't laziness — it's that existing tools are passive containers that ignore your cognitive state. FluxOS actively works against the gap.

friction.title: Cognitive Friction
friction.desc: Adding a task in Notion or Jira requires choosing a workspace, template, and fields. FluxOS captures your intent in under 2 seconds — no structure required.

abstraction.title: Fear of Abstraction
abstraction.desc: “Learn a new language” stays on your list for years because you don't know where to start. Our AI breaks it into phases and concrete next steps automatically.

paralysis.title: Choice Paralysis
paralysis.desc: A list of 47 tasks triggers anxiety, not action. Todoist and Things show everything at once. FluxOS shows you only the one task that fits your energy and time right now.

Audience.title: Built For People Who Think
Audience.subtitle: Whether you're juggling a day job with side projects, managing ADHD, or simply tired of abandoned goals — FluxOS adapts to your reality.

adhd.title: ADHD & Executive Dysfunction

freelancers.title: Freelancers & Creators
freelancers.desc: Client work, personal brand, learning — FluxOS is the operating system that keeps every project moving forward in parallel.

Process.subtitle: Five stages. Zero friction. Every idea follows the same intelligent pipeline — from chaotic thought to completed action.

capture.desc: Type or speak your idea. No forms, no fields, no structure needed. It goes straight to your Inbox as a raw draft.

decompose.subtitle: Goals become actionable steps

reward.title: Reward

Features.title: Everything You Need to Execute
Features.subtitle: Six integrated capabilities that work together to close the execution gap at every level.

triage.title: Smart Triage
triage.desc: AI automatically analyzes every draft you capture — determining context, energy cost, and complexity. No more manual tagging or categorizing.

decompose.title: AI Decomposition
decompose.desc: Two-layer planning: strategic phases with expected outcomes, then tactical steps you can start immediately. Powered by GPT-4o and Claude.

focus.title: Adaptive Focus Sessions
focus.desc: Tell us your available time and energy level. We hide everything else and surface the single most optimal task for your current state.

energy.title: Energy Management
energy.desc: Tasks are tagged with energy requirements. The system factors in chronobiology, session momentum, and subjective fatigue to rank what you should do.

offline.title: Offline-First Sync
offline.desc: Capture ideas without internet. Everything saves locally to IndexedDB, then syncs automatically when connection returns. Zero data loss.

voice.title: Voice Capture
voice.desc: Tap the microphone and speak your thought. Speech-to-text converts it into a draft instantly — perfect for capturing ideas on the go.

FAQ.title: Common Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about bridging the gap between intention and action.

q1.a: It's that frustrating distance between your plans and your results. We often have great intentions, but when it's time to work, we feel overwhelmed by the question: 'Where do I even start?' This isn't laziness—it's friction. FluxOS eliminates this friction by breaking your big ideas into tiny, effortless steps that match your current energy level, making it easier to start than to stay stuck.

q2.q: Is my data really private and safe?
q2.a: Your privacy is our first priority. We use industry-standard security to ensure that your thoughts and tasks stay yours alone. We never share or sell your data, and we treat your personal information with the same care we'd want for our own.

q3.q: How does the AI intelligence work?
q3.a: Think of FluxOS as a smart partner that helps you think clearly. We use advanced AI to help you organize your day, prioritize what matters, and simplify complex projects—so you can spend less time planning and more time doing.

q4.q: Does it work when I'm offline?
q4.a: Yes. Whether you're on a plane or in a tunnel, you can keep capturing ideas. FluxOS saves your work locally and quietly syncs everything the moment you're back online, so you never lose a single thought.

q5.q: Can I use my voice to capture ideas?
q5.a: Absolutely. Just tap the microphone and speak. FluxOS will instantly turn your spoken words into a clear task, letting you stay in your flow without having to type everything out manually.

q6.q: Can I use it on my phone?
q6.a: FluxOS is designed to work beautifully on any device. It's fully optimized for mobile usage, making it just as easy to capture and manage your tasks on the go as it is at your desk.

q7.q: What if I want to take my data elsewhere?
q7.a: Your data belongs only to you. We've made it simple to export all your tasks and information at any time. We want you to stay because you love the experience, not because your data is stuck here.
